title: Elegant Turtle Urli Candle with Pink Floral Soy Wax Candle | Decorative Brass Finish Bowl for Home Decor, Diwali, Gifts & Table Centerpiece (Jasmine)
description: Bring elegance and warmth to your space with this handcrafted turtle urli candle. Designed in a beautiful antique gold turtle-shaped bowl, this decorative candle is filled with creamy soy wax and adorned with charming pink floral and heart-shaped wax details. The delicate design makes it a stunning centerpiece for your living room, bedroom, dining table, or pooja décor. Made from premium soy wax, the candle offers a clean and long-lasting burn while adding a soft glow to your surroundings. Its artistic design blends traditional charm with modern aesthetics, making it perfect for Diwali, festive celebrations, weddings, housewarming décor, or romantic table settings. Once the candle is finished, the elegant turtle bowl can be reused as a decorative urli or small organizer, making it both beautiful and practical. A lovely choice for gifting or adding a luxurious touch to your own home.
